lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs within these columns exhibit a staggered vertical arrangement with relatively uniform inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, aligning with the columns of circular blobs to form a grid-like structural pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible running longitudinally. These features are defined by a sharp intensity gradient, with high-luminance upper edges and dark shadow-casting lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a high density of small, irregularly sized high-luminance spots distributed across the entire visible surface, with higher clustering observed towards the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical gill slits are visible on the anterior flank, showing high contrast between the dark interior slits and the lighter surrounding skin.
